_note: Local Supabase test backend for the plastron supabase libraries. All values here are local CLI demo defaults (public) or throwaway test creds — safe to commit. Start with: `supabase start` then `./setup.sh` (from this dir). Tests may override via env: SUPABASE_TEST_URL / SUPABASE_TEST_ANON_KEY / SUPABASE_TEST_EMAIL / SUPABASE_TEST_PASSWORD.
